ozocerite: A dark waxy mineral, found associated with petroleum in some sandstones, used to make polishes.
ozonate: To treat or react with ozone; to ozonize.
ozonated: simple past and past participle of ozonate
ozonating: present participle and gerund of ozonate
ozonation: The act of treating with ozone.
ozone: An allotrope of oxygen (symbol O₃) having three atoms in the molecule instead of the usual two; it is a toxic gas, generated from oxygen by electrical discharge.
ozonide: the univalent anion, O₃⁻, derived from ozone
ozonised: simple past and past participle of ozonise
ozonises: third-person singular simple present indicative of ozonise
ozonising: present participle and gerund of ozonise
ozonize: To treat or react with ozone; to ozonate
ozonized: simple past and past participle of ozonize
ozonizer: A device that converts oxygen into ozone, normally by means of a silent electrical discharge; an ozone generator.
ozonizes: third-person singular simple present indicative of ozonize
ozonizing: present participle and gerund of ozonize
ozonosphere: A layer in part of the stratosphere that has a larger than normal concentration of ozone; the ozone layer.
